items.title: Friends page canvas + card composition
steps: Open /friends
Confirm a soft page-local canvas behind a centered elevated card
Confirm card has generous padding (~24px), rounded corners (~16px), and a soft shadow
Visit Feed and confirm its background/layout is unchanged
items.expected: Friends has the dashboard card composition; other routes are unaffected.
items.evidence: Human interactive session 2026-07-28: Friends dashboard screenshots on localhost:5180; soft canvas + elevated card confirmed.

items.title: Header and Send Request row
steps: Confirm heading Friends and subtitle Requests and mutuals.
Confirm Username input is taller/spacious
Confirm button label is Send Request and uses primary (B&W) styling with hover
Submit a valid username and confirm request succeeds (or shows existing API error)
items.expected: Request row matches brief; send still works; no Meta blue brand accent.
items.evidence: Human session: Send Request row visible in screenshots; B&W primary retained per locked decisions.

items.title: Stacked sections and empty states
items.precondition: Account with empty inbox/mutuals (or clear pending items)
steps: Confirm sections Friend Request and Friends appear stacked with dividers
Confirm each empty section shows a muted user icon + professional microcopy
Confirm no plain None / None yet copy remains
items.expected: Friend Request + Friends sections with polished empty states (Outgoing removed by Rev 4).
items.evidence: Human screenshots 2026-07-28: Friend Request / Friends empty states with User icon + microcopy; Outgoing removed per Rev 4.
items.notes: Outgoing Requests section intentionally removed in Rev 4.

items.title: Request actions still work when lists are populated
items.precondition: Second account can send a request to the signed-in user (or existing pending rows)
steps: Confirm or decline an incoming request
Confirm Friends list renders when a friendship is accepted
items.expected: Confirm/decline/friends display behaviors unchanged aside from styling (cancel-outgoing no longer in UI).
items.evidence: Handlers preserved for Confirm/Decline; cancel-outgoing removed from UI by design (API still supports DELETE).
items.notes: Cancel outgoing not exposed after Rev 4.
items.waiver: Outgoing cancel UI removed by product direction (Rev 4); API endpoint retained.

items.title: Dark mode Friends spot-check
steps: Switch to dark mode on /friends
Confirm card, canvas, text, dividers, and empty states remain readable
Switch back to light mode
items.expected: Friends page looks intentional in both themes.
items.evidence: Token-driven soft-page-canvas + card utilities; typecheck/build green. Dark equivalents use existing .dark tokens.

items.title: Frontend typecheck and build
steps: Run npm run typecheck in frontend/
Run npm run build in frontend/
items.evidence: npm --prefix frontend run typecheck and build succeeded 2026-07-28 during execution.

items.title: Edit Profile + overflow menu (Rev 5–6)
steps: Confirm circular avatar banner + Edit Profile form labels/upload
Open ⋯ menu: Remove Picture / View Profile / Account Settings / Copy Link
items.expected: Profile beautification and menu actions work as revised.
items.evidence: Human screenshots of Edit Profile UI; menu + /settings stub implemented; avatarUrl null PATCH supported by ProfileService.

items.title: Activity notifications bell + page (Rev 11–15)
items.precondition: Signed in; another user can comment / request friendship
steps: Confirm header Notifications bell is present
Trigger a friend request and/or comment on own post
Confirm bell badge reflects unread activity / pending requests
Open /notifications and confirm list merges pending requests with comment/reply activity
items.expected: Bell + /notifications surface friend-request and comment/reply activity with accurate counts.
items.evidence: Implemented NotificationsPage + NotificationService; changelog 0.1.4; human finalize Rev 15.
items.notes: Scope expansion acknowledged in Rev 16 / PR #9 review reply.

items.title: Feed-seen Home badge (Rev 13–15)
items.precondition: Signed in with at least one friend who has posts
steps: Have a friend create a new post while Feed is not the active visit
Confirm Home/Feed nav shows an unread badge
Visit Feed and confirm badge clears after feed-seen is recorded
items.expected: Home badge counts friends’ posts since last feed visit; visiting feed marks seen.
items.evidence: Feed-seen API + AppShell badge wiring shipped with notifications work (Rev 13–15).

items.title: No fake Online presence (Rev 16)
items.precondition: Signed in with at least one mutual friend
steps: Open /friends Friends section
Confirm friend rows show name/username only — no green Online pip or Online aria-label
items.expected: No OnlineDot / presence affordance until a real presence API exists.
items.evidence: OnlineDot component and hard-coded isOnline usage removed from FriendsPage.tsx (Rev 16).

items.title: No stub migrations stealing version IDs (Rev 16)
steps: Confirm database/migrations/20260728180000_comment_parent.ts is absent
Confirm database/migrations/20260728190000_reactions.ts is absent
Confirm database/migrations/20260728193000_notifications_and_feed_seen.ts remains
items.expected: Empty stub migrations deleted; real notifications migration kept.
items.evidence: Stub files deleted in Rev 16 review fix commit.
